about: Curated inputs for eustress-agent-census (G7.01). A tool listed here uses this valid_input instead of the one synthesized from its schema. The missing-parameter probe removes `missing_param` (default: the first required parameter) from the valid input. A curated `effect` replaces the default rule (payload for read-only tools, world digest otherwise) and must say why; it is copied into the artifact. setup and teardown steps run around every repetition and are never timed or classified. Placeholders: {universe} {universe_b} {workspace} {space} {space_name} {space2_name} {run} {probe} {rep} {uuid:<EntityName>}. File-tool paths are relative to the Universe root.

effect.why: It changes only the MCP session's active Universe, which no world digest can see; its reply reports whether the session changed.

update_entity.note: A required-only input would ask for no change at all; the position makes the effect observable.

stop_simulation.note: Started first, so stopping has something to stop.

pause_simulation.note: Started first, so pausing has something to pause.
